description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Runtime_CodeFrame, which creates code frames for compiled and cached Smarty templates. It includes a method create() that generates PHP code snippets based on template properties and cache state, and performs post-processing cleanup of PHP tags in output.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Runtime_CodeFrame
classes.description: Class responsible for creating code frames for Smarty templates, both compiled and cached, by generating PHP code with template details and cleaning up PHP tags.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Generates a PHP code snippet that includes template information, dependencies, and functions, formatted as a string. It also performs cleanup of PHP tags within the generated code.
